integrity.claim_scope: exact field-independent Kirillov index with the four-cycle exception
integrity.proof_kind: unimodular mixed-minor induction and alternating determinant obstruction

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns Gallo–Videla three-step graph Lie algebras of complete bipartite graphs with two nontrivial parts; it does not cover stars or all graph Lie algebras.
It calculates the minimum stabilizer dimension, not the full rank distribution or all orbit sizes.
The index formula is proved over any field, but explicit computational enumeration is restricted to listed finite fields.
Historical novelty remains qualified against unindexed equivalent statements; no independent audit is asserted.
title: Kirillov index of the three-step graph Lie algebras of complete bipartite graphs
